basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Image Processing and Computer Vision (IPCV)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Pázmány Péter Catholic University (PPKE, Budapest, Hungary - Coordinating Institution), Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (UAM, Madrid, Spain), and Université de Bordeaux (UBx, Bordeaux, France)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc - Triple Master's Degrees)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Image Processing and Computer Vision: Deep Learning for Vision, Medical Image Analysis, Autonomous Driving Perception, 3D Reconstruction, Augmented/Virtual Reality, and Biometric Recognition.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 25 fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per annual cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition (Partner Country category); Pakistani computer vision and machine learning engineers secure ~2 to 4 full scholarships annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (full standard duration of 120 ECTS Joint Master's program across Hungary, Spain, and France)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: €1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for full 24 months (€33,600 total)

nationality_requirements: Open to applicants worldwide (Partner Country category for Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit; evaluated on academic excellence, technical competencies, and motivation.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science / Engineering in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or Telecommunications (16 years education, 180-240 ECTS equivalent) with minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00 (or 78%+ aggregate) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: First-class honors or top 10% class percentile equivalent.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate foundation in linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability/statistics, digital signal and image processing, algorithms, and Python/C++.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally provided degree certificate is awarded prior to program commencement in September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Experience in computer vision libraries (OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow), generative vision, or robotics strengthens candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (minimum 6.0 in each sub-score) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (minimum 20 in each sub-score). Standardized test is mandatory under Erasmus Mundus consortium rules.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and examinations across all partner universities are 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply through the centralized IPCV online portal hosted by Pázmány Péter Catholic University.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicants who have previously received an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (EMJMD) scholarship are not eligible for a second one.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full participation and tuition fee waiver (€9,000 / year for Partner Country students) covering all consortia universities, laboratory fees, and library charges.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application via the official IPCV consortium portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Consortium universities assist with reserved student housing in Budapest, Madrid, and Bordeaux; rent is paid from the generous monthly living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Covered via monthly stipend (€300 - €600 / month rent)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living allowance of €1,400 per month disbursed for the full 24 months of the programme (€33,600 total; ~PKR 420,000 / month; ~PKR 10,080,000 total).

airfare.details: Consortium travel and installation grant embedded into the Erasmus+ scholarship allocation, covering international flights between Pakistan and European study tracks.

visa_fee.details: Schengen study visa and national residence permit fees across Hungary, Spain, and France are covered from the scholarship installation allocation.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive worldwide private health, accident, and repatriation insurance policy (Marsh or Dr. Walter) compliant with EACEA standards provided 100% free.

food_allowance.details: Covered through the monthly living stipend of €1,400.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to specialized GPU vision workstations, camera sensor hardware, VR headsets, and university computing licenses.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Consortium funding available for students presenting their Master's thesis research at premier computer vision conferences (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, MICCAI).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Inter-consortium mobility travel costs between Year 1 and Year 2 institutions (e.g., Budapest to Madrid and Bordeaux) are fully covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple premier European institutions (consortium mobility across Hungary, Spain, and France is mandatory).
participating_institutions: Pázmány Péter Catholic University (PPKE, Budapest, Hungary - Semester 1)
Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (UAM, Madrid, Spain - Semester 2)
Université de Bordeaux (UBx, Bordeaux, France - Semester 3)
Partner R&D Centers or Universities for Master's Thesis (Semester 4)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Consortium brings together top European centers in signal processing, optics, and computer vision: UAM is top 3 in Spain, UBx is a French excellence university, and PPKE leads Hungarian IT research.
available_majors: Mathematical Foundations of Image Processing and Machine Learning (PPKE)
Deep Learning, Video Analytics, and Biometrics (UAM)
3D Computer Vision, Medical Imaging, and Virtual Reality (UBx)
Industrial or Academic Master's Research Thesis (Consortium Partners)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years (4 semesters, 120 ECTS - Semester 1 in Budapest, Semester 2 in Madrid, Semester 3 in Bordeaux, Semester 4 for thesis)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree in CS/EE/Math (180-240 ECTS equivalence), minimum CGPA 3.4/4.0, standardized English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90), two academic recommendation letters, CV, and motivation essay.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: All applicants enter a centralized global competition; top-ranked scholars receive both program admission and the prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Demonstrate practical computer vision competence (e.g., published papers, GitHub implementations of deep learning vision models, PyTorch code repositories) in your CV and motivation essay.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the IPCV application portal, complete the online application form, fill in technical background questionnaires, and upload all required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review IPCV academic prerequisites and ensure valid English test scores (IELTS min 6.5 or TOEFL min 90).
Step 2: Register on the IPCV online application portal (https://ipcv.eu/apply/).
Step 3: Complete the academic profile, curriculum coursework breakdown, and motivation essay.
Step 4: Enter contact details for two academic referees who will receive automated links to submit confidential recommendation letters.
Step 5: Upload attested transcripts, Bachelor's degree certificate, detailed CV, motivation letter, and passport copy before the deadline (typically January 15).
Step 6: Consortium Academic Selection Board ranks all global applications and submits scholarship nomination list to EACEA.
Step 7: Shortlisted and selected candidates receive formal scholarship offer letters in late March or early April.
Step 8: Accept scholarship offer, receive official visa support package from PPKE, and apply for Hungarian Type D study visa at the Embassy of Hungary in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Single application via the IPCV portal serves as both program admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated institutional links dispatched directly to their official university email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured motivation letter (maximum 2 pages) addressing technical background, motivation for image processing and computer vision, and career aspirations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of technical domain of interest and intended thesis research direction in computer vision, generative vision, or medical imaging.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV detailing academic qualifications, technical skills, programming languages, and projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Selection is purely dossier-based; online interviews are conducted only in rare borderline instances.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 sub-scores) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, 20 sub-scores); GRE is recommended but not mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via the IPCV central application system.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Academic Transcripts
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 4-year Bachelor's in CS/EE/Math with minimum CGPA 3.40/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each section) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, 20 in each section).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Score report valid at time of application.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from university professors who taught or supervised previous research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional Pakistani university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Maximum 2-page essay detailing background, technical competencies, and motivation for computer vision.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Demonstrate clear knowledge of the IPCV curriculum across Budapest, Madrid, and Bordeaux.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Europass CV highlighting technical skills, programming proficiencies, and computer vision projects.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to GitHub and academic code repositories.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official certificate confirming permanent residence in Pakistan for the last 12 months (e.g. utility bill, domicile, employer/university letter).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required under Erasmus Mundus 12-month residency rule.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 3 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Centralized global application period runs annually from mid-October to mid-January. Strict cutoff.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in core vision, signal processing, and mathematics courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Final year capstone project, publications, technical code portfolio, and work experience)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry computer vision, machine learning, or software development experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of motivation letter, clarity of technical vision, and articulation)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Quality and depth of academic appraisals from professors)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint Academic Board comprising professors and coordinators from PPKE, UAM, and UBx.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two independent academic reviewers score each dossier according to a standardized 100-point rubric, followed by composite consortium ranking.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~20 to 25 Erasmus Mundus full scholarship awards globally
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.0% to 3.0% among high-caliber vision and AI applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.65+ / 4.00 or top 5% class rank from premier Pakistani computing universities (FAST-NUCES, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional computing foundations, strong computer vision practices, published research, or substantial GitHub project portfolios.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electronic engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, China, Vietnam, Nigeria, Brazil, Turkey, Colombia, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell Erasmus Mundus scholarship spots.
Applications are submitted solely via https://ipcv.eu/.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: IPCV does NOT charge any application fee. Any request for money is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The IPCV Consortium and the European Commission do not work with commercial agents or agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Police character certificate and legal attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 25,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer in Budapest: ~€400 (~PKR 120,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can stay in one university for the full 2 years. Reality: IPCV mandates multi-country mobility across Budapest, Madrid, and Bordeaux.

Myth: The scholarship stipend must be repaid if you don't return to Pakistan. Reality: Erasmus Mundus scholarships carry zero repayment obligations; scholars are free to pursue global careers or PhDs in Europe.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites claim GRE is required; GRE is recommended by IPCV but is NOT strictly mandatory.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and earn 60 ECTS per year without fail grades across all consortium universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance and mandatory participation in consortium academic activities and workshops.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit audit by the Consortium Coordinating Board at Pázmány Péter Catholic University.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work is legally permitted under national student visa rules in Hungary, Spain, and France, but discouraged due to intensive curriculum.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Zero return obligation; graduates receive European multiple Master's degrees and are eligible for European post-study work permits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Active participation in Erasmus Mundus Students and Alumni Association (EMA) activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Stipend discontinued upon unapproved abandonment of studies or expulsion for academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mobility track is fixed: Semester 1 Budapest, Semester 2 Madrid, Semester 3 Bordeaux, Semester 4 Thesis.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not applicable; curriculum is unified under the Image Processing and Computer Vision joint framework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for maximum 24 months; thesis completion beyond 24 months must be self-funded.
